purpose: Teach: イラストレーター/セレモニー/グラビア/コミケ/ゴシック/サイクリング/猪木/サンタクロース

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、有名なイラストレーターさんなんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer who comes in — the famous illustrator, you know? Mei was telling me about him.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle curiosity in the voice. Slight pause before the name, like sharing something she learned and wants to offer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の結婚セレモニーに出席されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That regular customer attended his friend's wedding ceremony, apparently. Mei mentioned it.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Each detail offered like a small gift. Pacing unhurried. Voice carries the sense of noticing the human behind the small talk.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、グラビアアイドルの写真集を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently he collects gravure idol photobooks — quite the collection, Mei said.
lines.style: No judgment, only gentle noticing. Slight warmth at the specificity of it. Voice stays quiet, intimate. Like sharing a secret that isn't really secret, just private.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コミケで同人誌を販売されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He sells doujinshi at Comiket, she told me. I had no idea.
lines.style: Mild surprise underneath the calm. Respect for the detail — someone creating, not just consuming. Voice catches slightly on the realisation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴシック様式の建築がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Gothic architecture is apparently his thing. He has very specific taste.
lines.style: Appreciative, recognising something kindred in the specificity. Quiet warmth. Voice lingers slightly on 'specific' — understanding what it means to care about one thing deeply.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、週末にサイクリングされるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He goes cycling on weekends. Just — out riding, I think.
lines.style: Lighter here. A small smile in the voice. Picturing him on the bike. Pace slows on 'out riding' — letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、猪木さんのプロレスがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He loves Inoki's wrestling, apparently. Professional wrestling, not the casual kind.
lines.style: Delight in the oddness of it. Voice brightens slightly. Clear admiration for someone who has genuine passions, even unusual ones.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様のためにサンタクロースを演じられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he dressed up as Santa for his child. He actually played Santa.
lines.style: Voice softens considerably. This detail lands differently — tenderness at the care it shows. Quiet wonder. Let the realisation sit in the pause before the last phrase.
